---
title: "LLM"
---

Local LLM tooling is not currently installed by `playbooks/lab-stack.yml`. There is no active `local_llm` tag in the main playbook.

::: {.callout-manual}
**🔧 Manual setup and configuration**

If a workstation needs Ollama, Open WebUI, or another local LLM service, install and document it as a lab-specific manual step until an Ansible role is added.
:::

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --list-tags
```
:::
